failure_summary.description: Returned the right person or referent with extra name parts, a list of alternatives, or a different conventional name form.
Answered with a related but wrong answer slot or entity despite existing guidance to follow the clue's requested relation and avoid yes/no or mechanism answers.
Returned an altered work title instead of restoring the source title described by a word-substitution clue.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers concise answer granularity, name parts, relation tracking, and avoiding unrequested True/False answers, so those failures do not warrant duplicating rules. It lacks a specific rule for clues describing a source title altered by substitution; add guidance to reverse that substitution when the source title is requested.

edits.content: - For a clue describing a parody or adaptation title as a source title with one word changed or substituted, use the stated transformation and context to identify which title is requested. If the clue asks for the source work or title, reverse the substitution and return the original title, not the altered title.
